indications:
Midazolam in 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection is indicated:
                  
                     
                        •Continuous intravenous infusion for sedation of intubated and mechanically ventilated adult, pediatric, and neonatal patients as a component of anesthesia or during treatment in a critical care setting.
contraindications: • For intravenous injection only. Avoid intra-arterial injection or extravasation. ( 2.1 ) • Individualize dosing and titrate to desired clinical response, taking into account patient age, clinical status, and concomitant use of other CNS depressants. ( 2.1 ) • See Full Prescribing Information for complete dosage and administration information. ( 2 )

adverseReactions:
Midazolam in 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection is contraindicated in patients with:
                  
                     
                        •Known hypersensitivity to midazolam
                     
                        •Acute narrow-angle glaucoma
